suggestions.title: Path variables
suggestions.body: Store paths like $PROJECTS/upex with roots in config.json. Moving the projects folder or a drive letter means one edit, not 40.

suggestions.title: Per-machine path mapping
suggestions.body: Same links.json on two PCs where E:\ on one is D:\ on the other. Map roots per hostname so export/import just works.

suggestions.title: upex sync
suggestions.body: Keep links.json + config.json in a git repo or cloud folder and pull/push on demand. Builds on export/import.

suggestions.title: On-open hooks per shortcut
suggestions.body: Optional command run when a shortcut opens (git pull, docker compose up, nvm use). Turns opening a project into starting it.

suggestions.title: Per-shortcut env vars
suggestions.body: Env vars injected into terminals opened from a shortcut (NODE_ENV, PORT, API keys from a file). Pairs with cmd and claude openers.

suggestions.title: Import from other tools
suggestions.body: Seed shortcuts from VS Code recent workspaces, zoxide/autojump history or Windows Terminal profiles.

suggestions.title: WSL and remote openers
suggestions.body: Open a shortcut in a WSL terminal (path translated) or in VS Code Remote-SSH / dev container.

suggestions.title: upex new <name> --template
suggestions.body: Create a folder from a template (copy dir or git clone), register it and open it in one step.

suggestions.title: JSON output flag
suggestions.body: list, go, tag and doctor print machine-readable JSON with --json. Makes upex scriptable from other tools and agents.

suggestions.title: Dry run for openers
suggestions.body: A dry-run flag prints the exact command upex would spawn instead of running it. Debugs custom openers and platform quirks fast.
